_help: The equipment window (UIEquip.img). x/y = the window top-left in 1366x768 game pixels; w/h = the frame size (both backgrounds are 366x444); bgX/bgY = the background origin. contentX/contentY = the page canvas origin (all five canvases start at 12,61). tabY/tabH = the tab row (both rows sit at 31 and are 22 tall). titleH = the strip at the window top that drags the window. equipTab0X/equipTab1X/equipTabW = the two Equipment-page tabs. decoTab0X/decoTab1X/decoTab2X/decoTabW0/decoTabW1/decoTabW2 = the three Decoration-page tabs. slotX/slotY = the top-left of the 7x6 slot grid; slotPitchX/slotPitchY = the cell pitch; slotSize = the item box. switchX/switchYEquip = the Decorations button on the Equipment page, switchX/switchYDeco = the Equipment button on the Outfits page, switchW/switchH = their box. closeX/closeY/closeW/closeH = the X button.
